name: prefilter_lethal_attack
description: boss-ai C4 / C6 pre-filter with attacks (code review 2026-11-04, BAI-005 S4; the review's probe P7 board plus one 1/1): default band 2 with budgets.max_evals_per_action lowered to 10. The player hero is at 1 with three 1/2s and a 1/1; the boss has two awake 1/3 attackers and a hand of one aoe spell (damage 1 to all_enemy_minions: 4 targets) and five 2-damage minion-only removal spells (4 legal targets each). That is 32 candidates: 21 plays, 10 attacks (2 attackers x 4 minions + the hero), end_turn. Each attacker's face attack is lethal (1 attack >= 1 health); each attack on the 1/1 kills it. No card here has a discover or choose_one op.
